query:
SELECT h.id, h.name,
               EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM habit_completions c
                   WHERE c.habit_id = h.id AND c.date = $2
               ) AS "completed!"
        FROM habits h
        WHERE h.user_id = $1
          AND h.archived_at IS NULL
          AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM $2::date)::smallint = ANY (h.weekdays)
        ORDER BY h.sort_order, h.created_at
